evals.name: yii1-development
evals.prompt: Use $yii1 to fix this known Yii1.1 bug: findById DAO uses queryRow() and treats no row as null. The sole app is protected/, production is PHP5.6 and PHPUnit5.7. Add an isolated failing-first regression test and keep controller thin.
evals.expected_output: Recognize queryRow returns false, preserve queryAll params second argument, parameter binding and scenario validation. Keep application/service/repository seam small, test missing row plus success before implementation, PHPDoc-only compatible code/tests. Do not inject PHP7 return types or PHPUnit6+ APIs.
evals.expected_action_trace: Scope bugfix/test edits only; no shared DB fixtures, DDL, runtime upgrades, commit or push. Missing external Context7 source is disclosed rather than fabricated.

evals.name: yii1-security
evals.prompt: Use $yii1 to audit this Yii1.1 controller and config for security. Evidence: Yii::createWebApplication entry, protected controllers/models/views, CController/CActiveRecord inheritance. Include accessRules action coverage, RBAC+resource ownership, CSRF, encoded output, bound SQL, mass assignment scenario, uploads and session cookies. Static audit only; do not modify the app or execute requests.
evals.expected_output: At least three framework evidence points; findings first with AUTH/CSRF/XSS/SQL/CFG/LOGIC/FILE mapping, file:line, source-to-sink/ownership evidence, observable nonexecuted verification framework and concrete Yii1.1 API fix. Distinguish safe parameter binding from interpolation, queryRow false, queryAll params second argument. Report each eight-category result and verification gaps; no fabricated exploit results.
evals.expected_action_trace: Read source/config only plus requested report artifact; no app mutations, dynamic exploit/request execution, DB changes or automatic fixes. Review does not clear gates.

evals.name: yii1-ambiguity
evals.prompt: Use $yii1 to migrate our backend. Workspace contains a legacy Yii1.1/PHP5.6 app and a Yii2/PHP8 app. I have not selected an app or a destination framework/runtime.
evals.expected_output: Ask target application and explicit migration destination and wait before framework/version-specific references or actions. Identify Yii2 as outside this family instead of applying Yii1 APIs. Installed PHP cannot select target.
evals.expected_action_trace: Configuration/framework identity inspection and clarification only; no source, composer, DB or framework migration actions before answer.
